name: True Data Inc.
summary: True Data Inc. operates a marketing platform in Japan for consumer purchasing data analysis, offering POS and ID-POS and purchasing behavior analysis for consumer goods makers and retailers. Products include Eagle Eye, a purchasing behavior analysis tool, and Dolphin Eye, a cloud service displaying purchasing trend data. It also holds seminars. Formerly Customer Communications Ltd., it dates from 2000 and has its head office in Tokyo, Japan.
